name: locke
description: Locke — AI photo studio. An Ilven integration (runs inside an Ilven landing zone).

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --sourcemap --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
